verdict.rationale: Refunds are mentioned only indirectly, e.g. AI/MCP docs say agents can 'process customer refunds' and MCP can 'analyze revenue, refunds, and transaction patterns,' implying refund capability exists in the underlying API, but no dedicated dashboard or API documentation on issuing full/partial refunds is present in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit API endpoint or dashboard walkthrough for issuing refunds, confirmation of partial-refund support, and independent/hands-on evidence of refund flow working.
